column3: The oath is described as of God, without an explicit your or before.
Who will say is asked, without a separate verb can.
The command lacks an expressed his, and avoiding harm is literally knowing no evil thing.
The second question concerns how or when it will be, rather than repeating what will come.
The day of death lacks an expressed his; wickedness fails to rescue its possessors.
Giving the heart to the deeds is the literal expression for applying the mind.
The people are forgotten in the city rather than praised; this is a wording difference.
The heart of humankind is singular.
The sinner is described as prolonging for himself, without a separately expressed object life.
I said is expressed as completed.
God has given the days is expressed as completed.
The speaker gives his heart to knowing wisdom.
Finding out the work is repeated without separately naming its meaning.
